subject: Aurora pilot pricing options and token economics — pilot invoice next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@auroramedia.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: pilot sizing & next steps

Claire — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Call summary
- Pilot scope: 60-day pilot to evaluate audio-ad personalization pipeline (inference + embeddings + reranking).
- Initial token estimate: ~50M tokens/month in month 1 of pilot (peak), with potential ramp to ~150M/month if metrics look good.
- Budget ballpark you gave on the call: $80k–$120k for the 60-day pilot.
- Primary asks from Aurora: metered vs committed pricing options, a line-item invoice for finance/PO, and confirmation of any procurement requirements.

Unit economics targets we discussed
- Aurora target: ~$700–$900 per 1M tokens (flexible depending on commitment and caching).
- Redwood typical ranges (quick guide): metered hosted ~ $950/1M, optimized quantized ~ $700/1M, committed/dedicated ~ $650/1M (at scale/longer commit). Caching/prefix reuse can reduce effective token consumption by ~10–20% depending on workload.

Next steps (owners)
- Vanessa: produce a simple cost model with line items for 50M tokens/month at both metered and committed tiers — attach as spreadsheet. (ETA: today EOD)
- Me: produce an invoice estimate / SOW stub that finance can use for a PO. I’ll include a DocuSign-ready SOW link once you confirm budget/term.
- Claire/Tom: confirm whether you’ll do metered with a not-to-exceed cap or a committed short-term minimum. Also confirm PO routing (procurement email) and any other contractual constraints.

If you want any adjustments to the volume assumptions before Vanessa builds the model, call it out here. Otherwise we’ll send the estimated invoice + spreadsheet this afternoon.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment planned: aurora_pilot_cost_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@auroramedia.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:34:12 -0700
Subject: Aurora pilot — cost model (spreadsheet attached)

Hi Claire — attaching the cost model from our end. I pulled the numbers based on the 50M tokens/month pilot assumption Sean captured. Attachment: aurora_pilot_cost_model_v1.xlsx (38 KB).

Snapshot (rounded):
- Scenario A — Metered (hosted)
  • Unit price: $950 / 1M tokens
  • Monthly cost @50M: $47,500
  • 60-day pilot estimate: $95,000

- Scenario B — Optimized quant + caching
  • Unit price: $700 / 1M tokens (reflects quantization + caching estimates)
  • Effective token savings: ~15% assumed -> billed equivalent ~42.5M
  • Monthly cost @50M (net): $35,000
  • 60-day pilot estimate: $70,000

- Scenario C — Dedicated / committed pricing (3-month minimum recommended)
  • Unit price: $650 / 1M tokens (requires commitment / reserved capacity)
  • Monthly cost @50M: $32,500
  • 60-day pilot would typically be converted to a 3-month contractual minimum for the discount; we can price a pro-rated option if you prefer short pilot discounts.

Other line items (included in attached model)
- Setup/onboarding: $1,500 (one-time)
- Optional tracing/instrumentation add-on for deeper latency analysis: $2,500 (one-time)

Notes
- All figures exclude taxes/VAT.
- If you expect a higher peak week during the pilot, highlight expected burst tokens — we’ll include a burst buffer for capacity planning.

Next step: if you confirm metered vs committed and the PO email, I’ll convert this into a one-page invoice estimate (PDF) and send it to your finance team today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

[Attachment: aurora_pilot_cost_model_v1.xlsx (38 KB)]

From: Claire Park <claire.park@auroramedia.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@auroramedia.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 13:02:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora pilot — cost model (spreadsheet attached)

Thanks Sean / Vanessa — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed pilot length: 60 days (we want results quickly).
- Confirmed initial monthly volume estimate: 50M tokens/month (this is conservative; we may see spikes).
- Budget: we can allocate $100,000 for the 60-day pilot (including setup). We’d prefer metered billing but require a not-to-exceed cap at $100k unless we explicitly approve overage.
- Procurement: send the invoice estimate to procurement@auroramedia.com. We’ll raise a PO once we have the line-item estimate.

Can you send a one-page invoice estimate (PDF) that lists line items (setup, metered tokens @950/1M and the quantized option @700/1M so finance can compare)? If you can include a short note about how caching savings are calculated that would help.

Also: our legal team may ask for shorter data retention guarantees for this pilot — I’ll loop legal if needed, but please keep that on the radar.

On timing: we need the invoice in our hands today so procurement can process the PO early next week.

Best,
Claire Park
Head of Product, Aurora Media
claire.park@auroramedia.com

Claire / Tom — attaching the one-page invoice estimate you can send to procurement. Attachment: Aurora_Pilot_Invoice_Estimate_v1.pdf (12 KB). I also added a short note below that you can paste into the PO.

Invoice summary (60-day pilot, conservative 50M/month):
- Setup & onboarding (one-time): $1,500
- Metered hosting (Scenario A): 50M tokens/month @ $950 / 1M = $47,500 / month
  • 60-day metered total: $95,000
- Optional: quantized+cache scenario (Scenario B) shown for comparison: 50M/month effective billed eq. 42.5M @ $700 / 1M = $29,750 / month -> 60-day $59,500

Suggested purchase order language (paste into PO):
"60-day metered pilot for inference services (Aurora Media). Initial estimate $96,500 total (includes one-time setup fee). Not-to-exceed cap: $100,000 unless Aurora authorizes overages. Billing: monthly invoice; payment terms net 30. See attached estimate for line-item pricing and optional committed discounts."

DocuSign link for SOW / signature (optional): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-aurora-pilot-2026

Next steps
- If procurement confirms PO routing (procurement@auroramedia.com) + approval for the $100k cap, we’ll lock the pilot start date and spin up the environment.
- Monica (cc) will take ownership of onboarding; she’ll coordinate technical kickoff and instrumentation once the PO or signed SOW is returned.

I’ll follow up if procurement has any invoice-format questions. Thanks — look forward to getting Aurora going.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
